globalThis.comparison = (async () => {
  const face = new FontFace('NimboShape', 'url(/font-shaping-assets/' + variant + ')');
  document.fonts.add(face);
  await face.load();
  const canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(8, 8);
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const size = 10 + variant;
  context.font = size + 'px NimboShape';
  const near = (actual, expected) => Math.abs(actual - expected) < 0.001;
  const checks = {};
  for (const [name, text, units] of [['a','A',600],['b','B',700],['pair','AB',900],['kerning','BA',1250],['space','A B',1550],['euro','€',800],['accent','é',550],['decomposed','e\u0301',550],['empty','',0],['repeat','ABAB',1800],['white','A\tB',1550],['newLine','A\nB',1550]])
    checks[name] = near(context.measureText(text).width, units * size / 1000);
  checks.sameFont = context.font === size + 'px NimboShape';
  context.font = 'invalid';
  checks.invalidIgnored = context.font === size + 'px NimboShape';
  const metrics = context.measureText('AB');
  checks.metricsBrand = metrics instanceof TextMetrics && Object.prototype.toString.call(metrics) === '[object TextMetrics]';
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(TextMetrics.prototype, 'width');
  checks.metricsReadonly = !!descriptor && typeof descriptor.get === 'function' && descriptor.set === undefined;
  let missing = false;
  try { context.measureText(); } catch (error) { missing = error instanceof TypeError; }
  checks.requiredArgument = missing;
  context.save();
  context.font = '20px NimboShape';
  context.restore();
  checks.restoreFont = near(context.measureText('AB').width, 900 * size / 1000);
  const bytes = await (await fetch('/font-shaping-assets/' + variant)).arrayBuffer();
  const binary = new FontFace('NimboBinary', bytes);
  document.fonts.add(binary);
  context.font = '16px NimboBinary';
  checks.binaryFont = near(context.measureText('AB').width,14.4);
  checks.binaryLoaded = binary.status === 'loaded';
  new Uint8Array(bytes).fill(0);
  checks.fontOwnsBytes = near(context.measureText('AB').width,14.4);
  checks.hiddenNativeBridge = typeof globalThis.nimboFontMeasure === 'undefined' && typeof globalThis.nimboFontData === 'undefined';
  context.reset();
  checks.resetFont = context.font === '10px sans-serif';
  context.font = '16px NimboBinary';
  canvas.width = 8;
  checks.resizeFont = context.font === '10px sans-serif';
  context.font = '16px/2 NimboBinary';
  checks.ignoredLineHeight = context.font === '16px NimboBinary';
  let branded = false;
  try { descriptor.get.call({}); } catch (error) { branded = error instanceof TypeError; }
  checks.metricsReceiver = branded;
  Object.defineProperty(face,'status',{get(){throw new Error('spoofed font status');}});
  context.font = '16px NimboShape';
  checks.privateFontState = near(context.measureText('AB').width,14.4);
  return checks;
})();
